body.text:
Mara Vell's [wimpLink artistId="400100"]Harbor Lights[/wimpLink] is a quiet, coastal record.

Written over one winter, its four songs trade big choruses for "porch light" detail.
The Lantern Choir recorded Low Tide Hymns in a seaside chapel, and the room is part of the sound.

Mara Vell is a songwriter from a fictional harbor town.
She records at home and tours with a small band.
The Lantern Choir is a twelve-voice ensemble that sings in [wimpLink artistId="400200"]churches[/wimpLink] and boathouses.
Okonkwo Quartet plays late-night standards and originals.
